name: All Social Share – Sticky & Floating Share Buttons for WordPress
author: Kirtikumar Solanki

sections.description:
All Social Share – Sticky & Floating Share Buttons for WordPress is a simple yet powerful plugin to add social sharing buttons to your WordPress posts, pages, or products. Designed to be lightweight, mobile-ready, and theme-compatible, it allows visitors to easily share your content across multiple social platforms.

🔹 Key Features:

  • Add social share buttons to posts, pages, products
  • Choose display position: left, right, or below content
  • Supports major networks: Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Pinterest, WhatsApp, Reddit, Tumblr, Flipboard, Pocket, Email, Telegram, Gmail, Print
  • New: Copy Link Button – lets users quickly copy the current page URL to their clipboard
  • Responsive and mobile friendly
  • Admin settings panel for quick customization
  • Custom icon color picker for frontend icons
  • Toggle which icons to show (enable/disable per platform)

Usage

Once configured, share buttons will automatically appear on your selected post types (e.g., posts, pages, products). You can control:

  • Where the buttons appear (left, right, below content)
  • Which social networks to show
  • Whether to display on mobile
  • Icon color and styling options

New Feature

🎨 Set Custom Color for Icons
You can now select your preferred color for the social share icons from the admin settings. The selected color will be applied to all icons on the frontend automatically.

📋 Copy Link Button Added
A new “Copy” icon is now available in the social icons list. When clicked, it instantly copies the current page URL from the browser’s address bar to the clipboard. Easily enable or disable it from the settings panel.

🆕 New Platforms Added: Reddit, Tumblr, Flipboard, and Pocket
Now your visitors can share your content directly on these popular platforms.
Each share button uses the platform’s official sharing URL for reliable performance.

Supported Networks (with Privacy Policy Links)

This plugin uses the following external services to enable sharing:

  • Facebook
    • Share URL: https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php
    • Privacy Policy
  • Twitter
    • Share URL: https://twitter.com/intent/tweet
    • Privacy Policy
  • LinkedIn
    • Share URL: https://www.linkedin.com/shareArticle
    • Privacy Policy
  • Pinterest
    • Share URL: https://pinterest.com/pin/create/button/
    • Privacy Policy
  • WhatsApp
    • Share URL: https://api.whatsapp.com/send
    • Privacy Policy
  • Reddit
    • Share URL: https://www.reddit.com/submit
    • Privacy Policy
  • Tumblr
    • Share URL: https://www.tumblr.com/widgets/share/tool
    • Privacy Policy
  • Flipboard
    • Share URL: https://share.flipboard.com/bookmarklet/popout
    • Privacy Policy
  • Pocket
    • Share URL: https://getpocket.com/save
    • Privacy Policy
  • Gmail
    • Share URL: https://mail.google.com/mail/
    • Privacy Policy
  • Telegram
    • Share URL: https://t.me/share/url
    • Privacy Policy
  • Email (mailto link)
    • Uses browser-based default email client
  • Print
    • Opens the print dialog in the user’s browser
  • Copy
    • Copies the current page URL from the address bar (no external service)

Support

Need help or want to request a feature?
Reach out via WordPress.org support forum.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/all-social-share
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings → All Social Share to configure display options and networks
sections.faq:
Q: Can I change the color of the social icons?

A: Yes! Use the built-in color picker to apply your preferred color. Icons on the frontend will update automatically.

Q: Can I show only certain icons?

A: Yes. In the settings panel, you can toggle on/off each social platform.

Q: Can I disable sharing on mobile?

A: Yes, there’s an option to disable the display on mobile devices.

Q: What does the Copy icon do?

A: When users click the Copy icon, the plugin will automatically copy the current page’s URL to their clipboard. This is helpful for quick sharing via messaging apps or saving links.

Q: Why does Tumblr show “Not Available for Sharing” on localhost?

A: Tumblr blocks local or private URLs. Test with a live website URL instead.

Q: What if a platform updates its privacy policy?

A: You should periodically review each service’s privacy policy. We link to the latest versions above for convenience.
